verdicts.reason: Both use the same cramped stack. Text and the Shop Sale button sit about 6px from the side edges, 'WEEKEND ONLY' runs almost to the right edge, the footer wraps to leave 'only.' alone on its own line, and about 80px of dead space is left at the bottom. A also moves the lilac circle to the top corner, where it crops awkwardly and runs into the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow. B keeps the circle behind the product as in the original, though it slightly overlaps the bottom of the button.
